simple.meaning: גְּדוּלָה (gᵉdûwlâh) appears 13 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Esther, Psalms, beginning at 2 Samuel 7:21. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as kingship, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּדוּלָה (H1420) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גְּדוּלָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גְּדוּלָה (gᵉdûwlâh) / H1420 is tracked through 2 Samuel 7:21, 2 Samuel 7:23, 1 Chronicles 17:19, 1 Chronicles 17:21. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeem out of Egypt?

Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.
He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.
The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?”

All the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised!
Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts.
Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts.

definitions.full: H1420. gedullah גְּדוּלָּה noun feminine greatness — 2Sam 7:21 3 t.; גְּדֻלָּה 1Chr 29:11 ; construct גְּדֻלַּת Est 10:2 ; suffix גְּדוּלָּתוֺ 1:4 ; גְּדֻלָּתוֺ Psa 145:3 ; גְּדְלָּתִי 71:21 ; גְדֻלָּו֯תְךָ 145:6 ; plural intensive גְּדֻלּוֺת 1Chr 17:19 , 21 ; — chiefly late Hebrew a. of Psalmist Psa 71:21 ; Mordecai Est 6:3 ; 10:2 , king 1:4 ; b. of God's greatness , as an attribute 1Chr 29:11 ; Psa 145:3 ; 145:6 , or of his acts 2Sam 7:21 (compare Dr) 7:23 = 1Chr 17:19 (twice in verse); 17:21 . הַגְּדוֺלִים proper name, masculine father of Zabdiel Neh 11:14 (RV & so most; but ᵐ5 RVm and others the great ).
definitions.rootNote: or גְּדֻלָּה ; (shortened) or (less accurately) גְּדוּלָּה ; feminine of 1419 ;
